upgrades.name: Quantum Cargo Hold

upgrades.tooltip_extra: A long-term goal for your Seeker fleet. Permanent gem value and fleet upgrades make this easier to reach after prestige.

upgrades.name: Warp Drive
upgrades.tooltip: Trove Hunters warp to distant targets. The drive takes 10 seconds to recharge.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: A late-game fleet milestone. Prestige upgrades multiply gem value and fleet output to bring this within reach.

upgrades.name: Return Gate
upgrades.tooltip: Each full Trove Hunter has a 30% chance to open a gate and deliver its cargo instantly.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The final fleet milestone. Combine permanent value and fleet multipliers with a developed Trove Hunter fleet.

upgrades.name: Gem Value
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the bonus value of gems.

upgrades.name: Auto Cannon
upgrades.tooltip: Automates the cannon: it fires at the planet on its own. Until then, click the planet (or the homebase) to fire it.

upgrades.name: Mining Laser
upgrades.tooltip: Mounts a mining laser on the homebase. Its beam sweeps the planet and melts a steady stream of gems off the surface, landing close to the planet.

upgrades.name: Thermal Lance
upgrades.tooltip: Gems melted loose by the mining laser come out molten and are worth 50% more.

upgrades.name: Twin Lasers
upgrades.tooltip: A second mining laser fires alongside the first. The beams sweep separate halves of the planet out of step, so they never melt the same spot: the laser's output doubles.

upgrades.name: Rocket Pods
upgrades.tooltip: Fires a salvo of rockets every few seconds. Each rocket blasts a chunk off the planet that lands as a cluster of gems.

upgrades.name: Big Space Gun
upgrades.tooltip: A heavy gun that charges up and fires one massive shell. The impact shakes the planet and throws big clusters of gems across the whole field.

upgrades.name: Max Gem Count
upgrades.tooltip: Performance cap on gems in the field. Not part of the upgrade tree; fire rate and fire power decide how many gems come out.

upgrades.name: Expand Space
upgrades.tooltip: Expand space and prestige to earn purple gems and reset regular upgrades.

upgrades.name: Prestige
upgrades.tooltip: Prestige to earn purple gems and reset regular upgrades while keeping the current space size and camera zoom.

upgrades.name: Gem Synthesizer
upgrades.tooltip: Synthesize a steady supply of gems automatically every second.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank increases output. Gems go straight to your balance, with no collection needed.

upgrades.name: Ability Point
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the ability points by one.

upgrades.name: Homebase Collector
upgrades.tooltip: If enabled, the homebase will automatically collect gems within its collection range.

upgrades.name: Homebase Collection Range
upgrades.tooltip: Increase homebase collection range.

upgrades.name: Click Radius
upgrades.tooltip: Increase mouse click radius.

upgrades.name: Click Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: No tooltip

upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks Rimrunners that circle the edges, collecting gems along the way.
upgrades.tooltip_extra:
Base stats:
Speed: 120
Cargo: 20
Fuel: 100
Refueling: 50

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the movement speed of Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Collection Range
upgrades.tooltip: Increase collection radius for Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Capacity
upgrades.tooltip: Increase carrying capacity of Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Maximum Fuel
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the maximum fuel capacity for Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Refuel Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the speed of refueling for Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Fuel Efficiency
upgrades.tooltip: Increase fuel efficiency for Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Thrusters
upgrades.tooltip: Rimrunners move twice as fast near the edges.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Cargo Hold
upgrades.tooltip: Rimrunners have a 15% chance to deliver a gem instantly without using cargo space.

upgrades.name: Hands-on Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: Manually collected gems grant extra value when they reach home.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Applies to direct clicks, click chains, and shockwaves. Bonus value is added to the usual delivery payout.

upgrades.name: Gem Link
upgrades.tooltip: Each successful click chains to nearby gems and sends them home.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds another hop. Links start at the closest directly clicked gem; each hop finds the nearest available gem.

upgrades.name: Long Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the distance each Gem Link can jump.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Range is measured in world units. Longer links can bridge gaps between clusters.

upgrades.name: Click Combo
upgrades.tooltip: Consecutive successful clicks grant extra manual collection value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Click again within 2 seconds to keep your combo. Up to 10 stacks; each stack after the first adds the displayed bonus. Empty clicks do not build a combo.

upgrades.name: Combo Flow
upgrades.tooltip: Extend the time allowed between successful combo clicks.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds half a second to the combo window.

upgrades.name: Critical Touch
upgrades.tooltip: Chance for a successful click to triple its manual collection value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: One roll per click. Every directly clicked, linked, and shockwave gem shares the critical bonus.

upgrades.name: Gem Shockwave
upgrades.tooltip: Successful clicks sweep up extra gems within 90 world units.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds two nearby gems. The shockwave starts at the closest directly clicked gem, before Gem Link hops.

upgrades.name: Synth Overclock
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the frequency of Gem Synthesizer payouts.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Payout value stays the same. At +100% frequency the synthesizer pays every half second.

upgrades.name: Tap Dynamo
upgrades.tooltip: Each successful click advances the Gem Synthesizer timer.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The displayed value is seconds of synthesis per click, regardless of how many gems it collects. Requires an active synthesizer; chains cannot trigger extra charges.

upgrades.name: Sustained Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: Hold the left mouse button to collect gems repeatedly.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Starts with one click, then repeats every 0.8 seconds. Gem pickups can trigger Gem Link, shockwaves, combos, critical value, and Tap Dynamo. Pulses also refuel ships under the pointer; move the pointer to sweep the field.

upgrades.name: Pulse Frequency
upgrades.tooltip: Shorten the delay between held gem clicks.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: At +100% frequency, hold clicks repeat every 0.4 seconds. Stacks with Hold Momentum. Manual clicks still trigger immediately.

upgrades.name: Hold Momentum
upgrades.tooltip: Holding builds extra click frequency each second, up to five seconds.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The displayed bonus is frequency gained per second of holding. Release the button or move over the HUD to reset momentum. Minimum repeat interval: 0.08 seconds.

upgrades.name: Gravity Well
upgrades.tooltip: Hold right mouse to aim, then left-click to cast a gravity well.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Holding right mouse shows the radius and recharge, and disables normal gem clicks. Left-click while holding right mouse to cast. A red ring means the well is still on cooldown. Pulls loose gems toward the cast point for 2 seconds. Radius: 3 times your click radius. Cooldown: 20 seconds. Weaker than Homebase Magnetizer; gems still need to be collected.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the radius of your mouse gravity well.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Stacks with Click Radius. Each rank adds half your click radius to the well.

upgrades.name: Deeper Gravity
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the attraction of your mouse gravity well.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds 15% pull strength. Even at maximum rank, its pull stays weaker than the base Homebase Magnetizer.

upgrades.name: Lingering Singularity
upgrades.tooltip: Keep the gravity well active for longer.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds half a second. The well stays where you cast it; moving the pointer does not move it.

upgrades.name: Gravity Recharge
upgrades.tooltip: Shorten the cooldown of your mouse gravity well.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds 20% recharge frequency. At maximum rank, the cooldown drops from 20 to 10 seconds.

upgrades.name: Cannon Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The automated cannon fires faster.

upgrades.name: Cannon Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Each cannon shot, clicked or automatic, knocks loose more gems and throws them further. Harder hits reach deeper layers of the planet, where more valuable gem colors are.

upgrades.name: Shatter Shells
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon shots break off a chunk of the planet: the gems of each shot land together as a cluster.

upgrades.name: Laser Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The mining laser melts gems loose faster.

upgrades.name: Laser Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: The mining laser melts more gems loose. Harder hits reach deeper layers of the planet, where more valuable gem colors are.

upgrades.name: Arc Harpoon
upgrades.tooltip: Launches a tethered harpoon into the planet. Electrical pulses race down its cable and knock gems loose until the anchor retracts.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: A pulse weapon with a visible charge rhythm. Fire rate shortens both its reload and the time between pulses.

upgrades.name: Harpoon Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The Arc Harpoon reloads and sends electrical pulses faster.

upgrades.name: Harpoon Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Every Arc Harpoon pulse releases more gems and reaches deeper gem-quality layers.

upgrades.name: Conductive Barbs
upgrades.tooltip: The embedded harpoon holds for two additional electrical pulses before retracting.

upgrades.name: Deep Anchor
upgrades.tooltip: Every successive pulse penetrates one fire-power layer deeper, improving gem quality and debris reach until the harpoon retracts.

upgrades.name: Forked Current
upgrades.tooltip: Each pulse forks across the planet and releases an additional 50% of its gems at a second location.

upgrades.name: Capacitor Discharge
upgrades.tooltip: The final pulse overloads the anchor, violently releasing three additional pulses worth of gems.

upgrades.name: Tectonic Winch
upgrades.tooltip: Retracting the cable tears out a dense cluster worth two additional pulses near the homebase side of the planet.

upgrades.name: Rocket Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: Rocket Pods fire their salvos more often.

upgrades.name: Rocket Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Each rocket blasts a bigger cluster of gems off the planet. Harder hits reach deeper layers of the planet, where more valuable gem colors are.

upgrades.name: Rocket Count
upgrades.tooltip: More rockets in every salvo.

upgrades.name: Big Gun Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The Big Space Gun charges faster.

upgrades.name: Big Gun Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Each Big Space Gun fragment carries more gems. Harder hits reach deeper layers of the planet, where more valuable gem colors are.

upgrades.name: Fragmentation
upgrades.tooltip: The Big Space Gun's impact splits into more clusters, thrown across the whole field.

upgrades.name: Ricochet Rounds
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon shots bounce off the planet twice, arcing to new spots on its surface. Every bounce knocks loose 40% of the shot's gems again.

upgrades.name: Critical Shells
upgrades.tooltip: 15% of cannon shots, clicked or automatic, are critical hits: a huge blast that knocks loose five times the gems.

upgrades.name: Magma Scars
upgrades.tooltip: The mining laser leaves glowing scars of molten rock where it sweeps. Each scar keeps oozing gems for four seconds after the beam moves on.

upgrades.name: Overheat Surge
upgrades.tooltip: The laser heats up as it fires, glowing from orange to white. At full heat it surges into a massive white-hot beam that melts gems four times as fast, then vents to cool down.

upgrades.name: Cluster Warheads
upgrades.tooltip: Each rocket splits mid-flight into three mini-rockets that strike different spots. Every mini-rocket blasts off its own cluster of 60% of the rocket's gems.

upgrades.name: Orbital Strike
upgrades.tooltip: Rockets swing around the planet and strike its far side, throwing their clusters out the back of the planet with 25% more gems.

upgrades.name: Tectonic Shockwave
upgrades.tooltip: The Big Space Gun's impact sends a quake racing around the planet, shedding a ring of gems all around it worth half the shell's payload.

upgrades.name: Singularity Shell
upgrades.tooltip: After impact, the shell collapses into a black hole beside the planet. For a few seconds it tears gems out of the crust, as many again as the shell's payload.

upgrades.name: Dockside Reclamation
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet ships restore a portion of their fuel whenever they deliver cargo to the homebase.

upgrades.name: Emergency Autopilot
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. Stranded fleet ships automatically begin refueling without waiting for a manual order.

upgrades.name: Gatling Cannon
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. The cannon spins up into a gatling: it fires twice as often.

upgrades.name: Midas Touch
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. Gems you collect by hand, including with the gravity well, are worth three times as much.

upgrades.name: Golden Holds
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. Every harvester in the fleet delivers its cargo at double value.

upgrades.name: Quad Lasers
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. Two more mining lasers join the twin beams: four beams melt the planet at once.

upgrades.name: Rocket Swarm
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. Every salvo launches twice as many rockets.

upgrades.name: Doomsday Shell
upgrades.tooltip: Powerful upgrade. Big Space Gun shells carry a double payload, breaking twice as many gems loose.
